title: Kehte the aale Aba Margaye Zainab ke laal
body:
Kehte The Aale Aaba Margaye Zainab Ke Laal
Haaye Yeh Kya Hogya Margaye Zainab K Laal
1.Teer O Sina Khake Haaye, Gir Padhe Aur Sar Kataaye
Laash Koi Jaake Laaye, Margaye Zainab Ke Laal
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Mamu Par Qurba'n Huwe, Payas Se Bejaa'n Huwe
Zakhmo'n Se Haairan Huwe, Margaye Zainab Ke Laal
<<DIVIDER>>
3.Leate Hai Woh Sar Kataye, Aur Lahoo Me Nahahe
Kya Huwa Yeh Haaye Haaye, Margaye Zainab Ke Laal.
